sentences.text:
Bench: Suvra Ghosh 01.10.2024 rc/ct.no.34 Item No.41 CRR No. 45 of 2024 with CRAN No. 1 of 2024 In the matter of :
Rajat Kanti Ray @ Roy & Ors.
.......Petitioners
Mr. Amit Ranjan Pati Ms. Swastika Chowdhury ...for the petitioners Sk. Mustafi Rahaman Ms. Saswati Manna Ms. Mousumi Pal ...for the O.P Mr. Debasish Roy Mr. Sudip Kumar Mr. Karan Bapuli ...

for the State Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are the parents-in-law and sister-in-law of the private opposite party who has been residing away from her matrimonial home since 2016.

Besides the statement of the opposite party herself and her mother recorded under Section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, there is no material on record to suggest a prima facie offence against them under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the State refers to the Case Diary.
Learned counsel for the private opposite party submits that some of the documents of the private opposite party are still lying in the custody of the petitioners.
Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks to take instructions in this regard.
Let this matter appear under the same heading on November 21, 2024.

Further proceedings of ACGR Case No. 397 of 2023 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas be stayed till November 30, 2024 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
